notes.title: Bug Hunting...
notes.content:
Following Improvements Made:
- Collision detection more stable with Colossi.
- Mini-boss Death Flicker Fixed.
- Boost Achievements more stable.
- UI Overlap Fixed.
- Missile Trails.
- Missile Explosions.
- Death Screen Particle Effect Shadowing.
- General Visual Improvements.

notes.title: NEW ENEMY + BALLANCING
notes.content:
Dear Friends,

We've been hard at work, listened to your feedback, and have made improvements!

The balancing has been tweaked to make the game more accessible with a wider variety of plane combinations being feasible - turns out balancing so many (200 plus some change combined) parts to work together is a bit of a nightmare! Who would have thunk! This really is a hell of our own making :D

But we've got something that feels pretty good as of now :)

We've also added a new miniboss enemy - This chunky fellow helps break up the gameplay a bit and adds a bit of spice to the mix, making you have to adapt dynamically to his presence.

Other improvements we have made include:
- Visual flair: Visual polish really elevates the experience in our opinion.
- UI tweaks: Things are a little bit more comprehensible now.
- Challenges: We've smoothened the progression curve for a more consistent experience.
- A few minor bugs have been ironed out.

Now is the perfect time to hop in to the game!

We're still developing, so feel free to share your thoughts, and we hope you have a pleasant time with opollo.

With kind regards,

Planetary Gears

notes.title: First Early Access Update!
notes.content:
Hello Dear Friends,

We've listened to your feedback and made improvements!

For starters, we've added one new gun, one new engine and a new wing to the game, taking the possible player combinations to... 7 x 7 x 7 ... carry the 2... add 3... A whole boat load of possible combinations to mix and match and find a one that suits you!

We've also added the new Sniper colossus, for you to challenge, defeat and get some of those sweet sweet permanent multipliers.

Other improvements that we have made:
- Tweaked the balancing to make more combinations and play styles viable.
- Added some much needed gameplay UI for Health and Power readouts.
- Added more diverse and interesting challenges.
- Tweaked the Menu UI to be more communicative.
- Added a bit of subtle visual flair.
- Improved the combo streak system.
- Optimised things for a smoother experience.
- Fixed some small visual bugs.

Thank you to everyone who gave their feedback while we still work on developing th game further.

Now is the perfect time to hop back in or experience a better version of Opollo for the first time thanks to your guy's feedback.

Spread the good news!

We hope you have a nice time with Opollo and have fun defeating the Colossi!

With kind regards,

Planetary Gears
